messages:
Maya (Product): Quick sync: reviewing compact stepper for Private setup wizard on small screens. Noticed focus issues and CTA order confusion. Screenshot: https://redwood.design/s/stepper-compact
Aria (Design): On phones the stepper stacks and the primary CTA jumps under the sticky footer. Suggest a compact inline stepper: number + label + status dot, expand to details on tap.
Dev (Engineering): Implement as a single-button row that toggles a panel. CSS: `.step { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; } .step .label { min-width:0; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }` Keeps actions visible.
Liam (Accessibility): Important: the toggle must be a real button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. When panel opens, move focus to the panel header, not into logs. Add a visually-hidden summary that updates via aria-live=polite: "Step 3: 2 of 4 checks passed".
Noor (PM): Copy tweak: change vague statuses. Replace 'Partial' with 'Some checks failed 3/4 passed' and keep CTAs verb-first: 'Continue setup', 'Retry checks', 'View details'.
Aria (Design): Also chip contrast in compact mode is low. Use a 1px border and slightly darker text weight. I'll propose updated tokens for light+dark.
Dev (Engineering): Edge case: when many hosts expand simultaneously, we should collapse others to avoid long pages. Also debounce aria-live updates (200ms) to prevent screen reader verbosity.
Liam (Accessibility): Keyboard: allow Up/Down to move between steps when focused, and Enter/Space to expand. Provide clear focus outlines and avoid focus traps inside panels.
Maya (Product): Acceptance items I'll add: compact inline stepper for <=500px, toggle buttons with aria-expanded, aria-live summary updates debounced, chip color tokens AA contrast, CTAs verb-first. Post Figma and a short demo build when ready.
deploy-bot: Reminder: design review in 20 minutes in #product  bring mobile prototype :bell:
Aria (Design): I'll upload a Figma variant with the collapsed-other behavior and revised chips. Expect link in ~1h.
